collection.title: Xenium data of mouse rostro-caudal spinal cord

pilotGates.evidence: 16 current BIL dataset APIs and workbook rows declare CC-BY-4.0; site policy declares CC-BY-SA-4.0.
pilotGates.requiredInput: A consistent applicable rights statement for copied or derived boundary files; keep both declarations and source attribution.

pilotGates.evidence: Named Selection outlines are source labels; no cell_id-to-section table or declared outline-to-cell frame transform occurs in the acquired inputs.
pilotGates.requiredInput: Source-supported cell_id-to-section mapping, or source-declared outline frame, units, transform and section crosswalk.

pilotGates.evidence: Directory tokens, cassette labels and API specimen linkage keys differ; some API donor/tissue keys repeat across multiple run/slide records. They are retained separately.
pilotGates.requiredInput: Source-supported per-section donor/tissue mapping; do not apply a dataset-level specimen record to all ROI cells.

pilotGates.evidence: cells and cell/nucleus boundary payloads were not downloaded because section/frame admission remains unresolved.
pilotGates.requiredInput: Checksum-pinned small cells and cell/nucleus boundary inputs after prior gates, then duplicate/orphan/missing/ID and schema audit.

pilotGates.evidence: No exact curated cell_id label table was acquired; the gene panel and automatic clusters cannot identify interneurons.
pilotGates.requiredInput: Exact deposited cell_id-to-curated-class/type labels and provenance; otherwise retain source-only unresolved classification.

pilotGates.evidence: All acquired manifests declare XOA 3.3.0.1 with Multi-Tissue Stain, and metrics distinguish boundary, interior and nuclear-expansion counts.
pilotGates.requiredInput: Exact processing parameter evidence for nuclear expansion distance and per-cell method only if claimed; do not infer values from chemistry.

interpretation: Run/slide metadata and outline names are not identified cell geometry, biological animal counts, or an interneuron census.
